scientific_integrity: The proof reduces an all-instruction asymptotic claim to 2-adic conditional equidistribution and a complete 32-template symbolic count. Finite-prefix checks are explicitly auxiliary; no independent mathematical audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Exact pair frequencies of successive maximal run lengths only; higher-order run patterns and finite-block discrepancy bounds are not claimed. Historical overlap with an inaccessible full 1994 paper remains a priority risk.
title: Universal adjacent-run frequencies in generalized paperfolding words
